sections.text: مقدمة

This 
 document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must performed every two 
 months as indicated by M2 in the title block.
The Ljungstrom air heater absorbs waste heat from flue gases, then transfers this heat to incoming cold air to increase the temperature of the incoming combustion or air process.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Emad El din Ali Elbana, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by EDEPCo. inspection & quality control 
at eng Samir Abd El- Gelil, Approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif; head 
Sector of 
Abu Soltan Power Station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al 
Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.
